title: Pricing v3 Working Session
summary: Discussion covered Pricing v3, Packaging, Enterprise, Usage. The team reached 3 clear decision(s) and assigned follow-up work.
decisions: Move from four paid tiers to three
Keep core workflow usage bundled on Growth and Scale

action_items.task: Move from four paid tiers to three
Keep core workflow usage bundled on Growth and Scale

transcript.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
transcript.text: Let's focus today's discussion on Pricing v3, Packaging, Enterprise.

transcript.speaker: Kabir Shah
transcript.text: I am comfortable with the investment if we can see the unit economics and the downside case.

transcript.speaker: Meera Iyer
transcript.text: The market signal is consistent across the larger deals, especially in the US enterprise segment.

transcript.speaker: Neha Kulkarni
transcript.text: The data is strong enough to test this, but I want the success metric defined before launch.

transcript.speaker: Maya Fernandes
transcript.text: The story gets much clearer when the output itself is something users want to share.

transcript.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
transcript.text: My recommendation is that we move from four paid tiers to three.

transcript.speaker: Kabir Shah
transcript.text: My recommendation is that we keep core workflow usage bundled on Growth and Scale.

transcript.speaker: Meera Iyer
transcript.text: My recommendation is that we test an enterprise platform fee.

transcript.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
transcript.text: Okay, we are aligned on test an enterprise platform fee. Let's capture owners and move.
